raw_comment:
The map shows significant areas of drought across the United States, with the most severe conditions in parts of the Midwest, Mountain West, and Western regions. There are gradients of severity, ranging from "Abnormally Dry" to "Exceptional Drought."
I wonder what factors are contributing to this. How are farms and overall agricultural communities b being affected. Florida is only shown slightly. Drought Nation: Severe Dry Conditions Stretch Across the U.S.
